dead_end_checks: All 100 closed/open map routes checked; region bosses/gear gates have reachable return ladders.
Ancient/star materials are gatherable before their required gear upgrades; crystal/iron/starlight earlier available in original three mines.
21–100 ores regenerate after three legitimate days, avoid respawning under player; main mine repeatable sources retained.
One-time chest/core/quest/memory flags persist. Purchases cannot create positive diamond refining cycles.
Sleep before20 rejected; no arbitrary day skip. Resource model constrains energy instead of assuming 80 rare ores in a single day.
limits: Time inputs are assumptions, not measured human completion. Fixed-fps testing is not playtesting.
Calendar lower bound is not entertaining content. Prior 200–350h target remains unverified and is not achieved by this model.
Phone FPS, input comfort, battery and long-term retention require real devices and playtests.
